slides.text:
**How to make a web page print well: good, better, best.**

Brennen Puth hit Ctrl-P on his own blog and got oversized text and gray links.

Fixing it took him **a morning of CSS.**

panel.small: the export button you already shipped

slides.text:
Each level builds on the last.

**Which level is your site at? Save this.**
bullets: Good: just Ctrl-P. The nav and gray links print too.
Better: @media print. Black links, but code blocks split.
Best: add page-break rules. Backgrounds still drop.
